messages:
Anita (Partnerships): Heads up — trying a small change to the SI lead handoff rules for the Trellis pilot. want to confirm ops/ROE before we flip it on :eyes:
Devon (SI): ok describe the change?
Anita (Partnerships): instead of first-claim-wins we want a 48h staging window where Sales + SI can agree mapping, then it becomes locked to SI. reason: reduce bounced leads and duplicate outreach.
Sam (Sales): 48h seems fine for PD-led demos. worried if customer replies instantly and wants partner intro same day. any fast-path?
Priya (Field Eng): fast-path = if customer tags "urgent-intro" in the intake form or replies with meeting request, Sales can escalate to partner immediately. we should define the tag semantics.
Devon (SI): that makes sense. can we add a rule: if partner has pre-existing account relationship (SI CRM flag), they get immediate claim. otherwise staging window applies.
Anita (Partnerships): agreed. new rules proposal: 1) if SI-relationship flag set -> immediate claim. 2) if customer sets urgent-intro -> immediate claim. 3) else 48h staging for map/ownership confirmation. after 48h, lock to SI if claimed, else Sales reclaims.
Sam (Sales): quick Q: where does this show up in SFDC? we need fields for: lead_claim_status, claim_timestamp, si_relationship_bool, urgent_flag.
Priya (Field Eng): I mocked a mapping table — put in spreadsheet. quick snippet for the automation rule we can feed to opsbot:
```
if si_relationship_bool == true or urgent_flag == true:
  assign_to = si_owner
else:
  assign_to = staging_queue
  staging_deadline = now + 48h
```
Anita (Partnerships): +1. We'll have ops create a queue view called "Trellis staging". also want a human-in-loop email to both Sales + SI at claim start: "Please confirm ownership" with one-click buttons.
leadbot: new lead #T-2427 created (origin: cloud-marketplace). lead metadata: account=AcmeCo, region=NA, tags=[marketplace,hw-partner], si_relationship_bool=false
Devon (SI): for mapping, proposal: use account_domain to coalesce duplicates, then run manual stitch if multiple sellers claim. also need a no-contact window for 24h after claim to prevent duplicate outreach.
Sam (Sales): agree on dedupe by domain, but be careful with shared domains (subsidiaries). add manual override.
Anita (Partnerships): next steps: 1) Priya to drop spreadsheet + sample SFDC field list (by EOD). 2) DevOps/opsbot to draft the automation rule and staging queue (by Fri). 3) Sales to give 2 edge-case examples for subsidiary domains. 4) Partnerships to publish ROE doc and one-pager for partners.
Priya (Field Eng): spreadsheet link: https://tiny.redwood/trellis-mapping (contains proposed SFDC fields + quick decision matrix).
Devon (SI): we'll test two sample leads this week and report back. prefer a test that simulates urgent-intro flow.
Sam (Sales): noted. one more ask — metrics: can we add a dashboard widget for time-to-claim and % escalations so we can tune 48h?
Anita (Partnerships): yes — partnerships + sales ops will own metrics. add to roadmap: "Trellis lead metrics".
leadbot: automation note: claim window scheduled for lead #T-2427 -> staging_deadline = 1763335140
Devon (SI): thanks — i'll circle back after two test leads. if all good, we flip pilot next Tue at 9am PT. :thumbsup:
Anita (Partnerships): perfect. I'll draft the ROE and post the one-pager in this channel for sign-off before EOD Mon.
Sam (Sales): cheers.
Priya (Field Eng): thanks all
